hero.subtitle: An online prep platform for IC3 GS6 / GS7 / GS8 — a question bank that mirrors the real exam structure, mock exams on the real IC3 scoring scale, flashcard review, and a certificate the moment you pass.

trustBar.quote: All three IC3 exam versions, fully supported on one platform

features.title: Everything you need to earn your IC3 certification
features.subtitle: Purpose-built for IC3 exam prep and teaching — not a generic LMS.

items.title: Practice mapped to the real structure
items.desc: Exercises organized by Level 1-3 and Testing/GMetrix for each GS6/GS7/GS8 version.

items.title: Mock exams on the real IC3 scale
items.desc: GMetrix-style simulation scored 0-1000, with the same 700-point pass mark as the real exam.

items.title: Fast flashcard review
items.desc: Flip-card study, shuffled questions, instant self-scoring for every question type.

items.title: Live exam monitoring
items.desc: Teachers watch classes sit exams in real time, with tab-switch and fullscreen-exit detection.

items.title: Analytics & AI insights
items.desc: Score distribution charts, most-missed-question stats, and AI-generated commentary per class or school.

items.title: Completion certificates
items.desc: Instant PDF certificate on passing, with a full attempt history kept for every student.
